role: Transport and format specification for all48 frozen evaluation endpoints; does not change training or metric selection
inference: Use the original protocol: square640, batch32, FP32, conf0.001, class-aware NMS IoU0.7, max_det300 across all ten classes, no augmentation and no class filter before NMS. Explicitly slice the image list into32-image calls plus the final partial call: Ultralytics8.2.103 list-source input can ignore the batch argument. Verify actual input tensor shapes in the synthetic full/partial-batch test.
canonical_predictions: Save one all-class JSON record per image, including empty results. Retain original-image xyxy coordinates and confidence with Python JSON binary64 round-trip precision, original order and integer class IDs. Preserve every ten-class output before mapping to person0/car2. Model tensor values originate as float32.
image_integrity: Verify image ID uniqueness, exact filename order and original dimensions against the frozen image manifest. No missing, extra or duplicate result images are accepted.
square_geometry_enforcement: The installed Ultralytics8.2.103 default predictor ignores args.rect in pre_transform and auto-letterboxes equal-shape inputs. Use FixedSquarePredictor, overriding only pre_transform to LetterBox(auto=False). Retain native resizing defaults, postprocessing, class-aware NMS and coordinate restoration. Verify actual32-image and1-image tensors are both float32 with3x640x640 spatial/channel dimensions. This implements the original prespecified geometry; no real-data scores informed the correction.
validation: Fail on nonfinite or out-of-range confidence, fractional/unknown class IDs, over300 all-class predictions, reversed coordinates or coordinates outside the source image. Image-edge clipping can legitimately collapse predictions to zero width/height: retain all such records without silently dropping or altering them. Common COCO bbox matching gives zero overlap and retains them as false positives; native KITTI applies its original separate difficulty/height/ignore rules. Ground-truth boxes must still have positive area. This pre-scoring correction was triggered by synthetic inputs and is documented in prediction_io_correction_20261017.json.
common_metric: Map only BDD class0 to person0 and class2 to car2 after all-class NMS. Convert xyxy to continuous xywh without plus one. Both KITTI annotation variants consume identical predictions.
native_KITTI: Map the same class0/class2 outputs to Pedestrian/Car, preserve original-image xyxy, write16 KITTI fields with nine significant digits for coordinates/confidence. Nine digits preserve float32 round-trip. Native evaluator remains separately versioned and tested.
scope_limit: Synthetic transport tests do not validate model accuracy, the complete future evaluation runner, all real data, or annotation equivalence. A complete48endpoint/checkpoint manifest and per-image archive integrity checks are required before the real scoring phase. All48endpoints and both common KITTI variants must be reported.
